title: Forge MCP Tool Inventory
description: Static schema for the 10 MCP tools exposed by `forge mcp serve`. This file is the source of truth for contract tests (T-013) and CI validation.

tools.name: forge_kb_search
tools.description: Search the Forge knowledge base for patterns, best practices, and standards.

tools.name: forge_get_workflow
tools.description: Get the step-by-step workflow for any Forge verb.

tools.name: forge_get_standards
tools.description: Get coding standards active in this project.

tools.name: forge_run
tools.description: Execute any Forge verb and return its output.

tools.name: forge_ship_checkpoint
tools.description: Run a single forge ship checkpoint for a named feature.

tools.name: forge_get_errors
tools.description: Look up FORGE-XXXX error codes for descriptions and remedies.

tools.name: forge_set_budget
tools.description: Set FORGE_BUDGET_USD spend cap for subsequent forge commands.

tools.name: forge_list_specs
tools.description: List all feature specs in .forge/specs/ with checkpoint status.

tools.name: forge_get_spec
tools.description: Read a spec file (spec.md, arch.md, etc.) for a named feature.

tools.name: forge_check_health
tools.description: Run forge doctor and return a structured health report.
